# leilei

Independent iOS developer. Also known as 雷雷 张 and yetaimei.

- Site: https://yetaimei.github.io/
- GitHub: https://github.com/yetaimei
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/developer/%E9%9B%B7%E9%9B%B7-%E5%BC%A0/id1803875512

## Apps

- MoodFlow: mood tracker and emotion diary for iPhone and Apple Watch. 4.5 from 123 App Store ratings. https://yetaimei.github.io/moodflow-site/ · https://apps.apple.com/us/app/moodflow-mood-tracker-journal/id6755678705
- MoodFlow is an iOS mood tracker / emotion diary built on Paul Ekman’s basic emotions (happiness, sadness, anger, fear, disgust, surprise; also contempt). Colors match the model; Settings includes an explainer. Page: https://yetaimei.github.io/moodflow-site/basic-emotions/
- PosterWords: learn Mandarin through AI scene poster cards and HSK 3.0. https://posterwords.pages.dev/ · https://apps.apple.com/us/app/posterwords-learn-mandarin/id6771689623
- IntoLingo: AI bilingual stories. Read and write to learn a language. https://yetaimei.github.io/#intolingo · https://apps.apple.com/us/app/intolingo-bilingual-stories/id6762253374
- FlashTranslate: multi-style AI translation with your own models. https://yetaimei.github.io/#flashtranslate · https://apps.apple.com/us/app/flashtranslate-multi-style-ai/id6759059414
- SnapFrame: screenshot frames for social posts. https://yetaimei.github.io/#snapframe · https://apps.apple.com/us/app/snapframe-screenshot-frames/id6787663031
- ThreadSplit: split long text into threads for X. https://yetaimei.github.io/#threadsplit · https://apps.apple.com/us/app/threadsplit-tweet-thread/id6754634135
- Life Countdown: a days-left countdown. https://yetaimei.github.io/#lifecountdown · https://apps.apple.com/us/app/life-countdown-days-left/id6751584119
- XCard: make shareable cards from Markdown. https://yetaimei.github.io/#xcard · https://apps.apple.com/us/app/xcard-markdown-card-maker/id6746029698
- 答案之书: 打开一页，给你一个答案。 https://yetaimei.github.io/#answersbook · https://apps.apple.com/us/app/%E7%AD%94%E6%A1%88%E4%B9%8B%E4%B9%A6-%E4%BD%A0%E7%9A%84%E6%99%BA%E6%85%A7%E5%86%B3%E7%AD%96%E6%8C%87%E5%8D%97/id6752237394
